neighbours.label: The word piece 'exec' at the start of an English word, in any sense: execute, executed, execution, executive, executable, executor, execs, even execrable (and code's exec / os.execvp), plus Chinese 执行/執行 ('carry out'). Quiet: synonyms with no 'exec' (carry out, implement, run, perform, put to death, 实施) and look-alikes exercise, exempt, except, exceed.
neighbours.short: the word piece 'exec' (any sense) and Chinese 执行
